# Forge

The forge puts permanent effects on the faces of your die. Open crates with meta points to get effects, then choose a face to put one on. **Each face holds one effect**, so six faces means six choices.

## Crates

Every crate draws from all 15 effects. Dearer crates can't land below a certain rarity, which takes the commons (and more) out of the draw.

| Crate | Cost | <span class="swatch" style="background: rgb(158, 150, 178)" title="rgb(158, 150, 178)"></span> Common | <span class="swatch" style="background: rgb(90, 206, 160)" title="rgb(90, 206, 160)"></span> Uncommon | <span class="swatch" style="background: rgb(92, 170, 255)" title="rgb(92, 170, 255)"></span> Rare | <span class="swatch" style="background: rgb(190, 124, 255)" title="rgb(190, 124, 255)"></span> Epic | <span class="swatch" style="background: rgb(255, 178, 66)" title="rgb(255, 178, 66)"></span> Mythic |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 📦 Worn Crate | 150 meta | 56.11% | 27.05% | 13.03% | 3.61% | 0.2% |
| 🎁 Gilded Crate | 350 meta |  | 61.64% | 29.68% | 8.22% | 0.46% |
| 🔮 Astral Crate | 850 meta |  |  | 77.38% | 21.43% | 1.19% |

Every 40th crate you open is **Rare or better**, whichever crate it is.

## Effects

The crate columns are the chance of getting that exact effect from one crate. Weight effects make a face come up more or less often, so their size can't be given as a number.

### Common

| Effect | Kind | What it does | Worn Crate | Gilded Crate | Astral Crate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ☀️ Sunstone | Scoring | Roll this face and land on a light tile: the roll pays 1.5x. | 11.222% |  |  |
| 🌙 Moonstone | Scoring | Roll this face and land on a dark tile: the roll pays 1.5x. | 11.222% |  |  |
| 💨 Feather | Weight | This face sinks, so its opposite comes up more often. Only your heaviest weight works. | 11.222% |  |  |
| 👣 Nudge | Trigger | This face moves you one extra tile. | 11.222% |  |  |
| ⚡ Surge | Trigger | This face charges 0.2 more Spark, on top of what your source charges. | 11.222% |  |  |
